title: Surreal Lavender Dreamscape
description: A vibrant surreal landscape features a man with a red backpack standing on a grassy cliff overlooking endless lavender fields, facing a large circular bubble containing five colorful women's profiles in purple, green, pink, and yellow. To the right, a woman in a black gothic dress and chains stands at a market stall labeled 'Stellforge Insectarium - Garden of Chains' displaying pinned insects and lavender.
prompt: Surreal fantasy landscape with a hiker carrying a red backpack standing on a green cliff overlooking vast rolling fields of purple lavender under a fiery orange and red sunset sky, in the center a large transparent bubble contains five women's side profiles in vibrant purple green pink and yellow with long flowing hair, to the right a woman with long magenta hair wearing a black gothic dress with chains stands at a wooden market stall labeled Stellforge Insectarium Garden of Chains displaying pinned moths and butterflies with lavender sprigs, distant snow capped mountains and a castle with a black dragon flying nearby, detailed line art with vibrant colors
